title: The ShopEngine Gutenberg WooCommerce Builder Blocks Addon WordPress plugin before 2.4.4 does not validate the user's…
description: The ShopEngine Gutenberg WooCommerce Builder Blocks Addon WordPress plugin versions before 2.4.4 contains a vulnerability where it fails to validate user capabilities or ownership of targeted posts in an AJAX action. This flaw allows users with contributor-level roles to inject arbitrary JavaScript into any post, which executes when a higher privileged user edits the post.
